name: pick-omit
description: Selects or excludes keys from objects using key lists or predicate functions.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to create subset views of objects for API responses, strip sensitive fields, or filter object properties based on dynamic conditions.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: The source object to pick from or omit keys from.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Array of property keys to select (pick) or exclude (omit).
